articles.summary: New York – April 9, 2026 — Equitable, a leading financial services organization and principal franchise of Equitable Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: EQH), today announced the introduction of the Equitable Retirement Access℠ ERISA 403(b) pooled employer plan (PEP), a new offering designed to help nonprofit organizations offer a scalable, costefficient way to provide their employees with retirement plan benefits.
articles.title: Equitable launches 403(b) pooled employer plan to support nonprofits
